# On and off by default — the `airflow` pack

Back to [what a fresh install turns on](../defaults.md) · [every rule of the pack](../README.md#airflow).

- **Installed by `codelaw init` when:** never — installing the pack is the opt-in.
- **Rules:** 8 — 0 on, 0 on with `preview = true`, 1 off in an opt-in preset, 7 in no preset.

## Presets

| Preset | Written by `init` | Rules | Severities | What it is |
|---|---|--:|---|---|
| `airflow/recommended` | no — opt in | 1 | 1 warn | the 1 Ruff's `AIR` rules (Ruff 0.16.9) that Ruff calls stable, reimplemented (W-139) |
